title: This Game Is Fun!
creator: VOA Learning English
summaryTr: Anna, telefonundaki oyunda sanal simgeleri kovalarken Dan ile yarışa tutuşuyor. Puan toplamak kolay; önündeki ağacı fark etmek biraz daha zor!
levelNoteTr: Seviye, altyazı ve kelime desteğiyle dinleme için Lantern English tahminidir; resmî CEFR derecesi değildir. Ana skeçteki ekran altyazıları dokunulabilir olarak hazırlanmıştır. VOA’nın Dinle/Konuş tekrarları ve ara açıklamaları özgün hâliyle korunur; bu bölümlerde her cümle için dokunulabilir altyazı bulunmaz.

glossary.memorial: bir kişiyi veya olayı anmak için yapılan anıt
glossary.americana: Amerikan kültürüne ait şeyler; burada Anna adıyla kelime oyunu
glossary.bald: bald eagle: kel kartal; ABD simgesi olan kuş
glossary.liberty: özgürlük; Statue of Liberty: Özgürlük Heykeli

captions.text: This is the Roosevelt Memorial. Where is the symbol?
But this game is really fun.
You have to find things that aren't really there.
When you find an American symbol, you win points and
a Fun Fact about a U.S. president.
Yay! I found Uncle Sam and I won 40 points!
What is the Fun Fact?
Franklin Roosevelt was the first to fly in a plane as president!
I didn't know that. This is a really beautiful memorial.
I found it! The Statue of Liberty! Please give me my Fun Fact.
Abraham Lincoln was a great wrestler!
I didn't know that. Lincoln wanted freedom for all people.
So, the Statue of Liberty works well.
And I won 20 points! Time to find the next symbol.
Hey! Look out!
Sorry. Hey, it's you! Now, I should be more careful.
That's okay.
This game is a lot of fun. What's your name?
Dan. What's yours?
Anna.
Like Americana!
Yeah, I guess so.
Did you find any symbols?
Yes, I found three and I won 120 points!
Me too. But, did you find the bald eagle?
No. Did you?
No.
First one to find it wins?
Hey Anna, look out for that tree!
I learned a lot about presidents with this game.
But I ought to be more careful.
Until next time!
